cards.ex: After his illness, he was all skin and bones.
cards.exUz: Kasalidan keyin u teri suyak bo'lib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ozg'in, go'shti yo'q odamni tasvirlash.

cards.ex: She has a face that could launch a thousand ships; her beauty is captivating.
cards.exUz: Uning yuzi mingta kemani yo'lga solishi mumkin; uning go'zalligi o'ziga tortadi.
cards.term: a face that could launch a thousand ships
cards.uzDef: Juda chiroyli, odamlarni hayratga soladigan yuz.

cards.ex: Her height runs in the family; everyone is tall.
cards.exUz: Uning bo'yi nasldan o'tgan; hamma baland bo'yli.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolarida o'xshash xususiyatlar borligini anglatadi.

cards.ex: The new design is very easy on the eye.
cards.exUz: Yangi dizayn juda ko'zga yoqimli.
cards.uzDef: Qarashga yoqimli, go'zal yoki chiroyli.

cards.ex: After retiring, he let himself go and stopped exercising.
cards.exUz: Nafaqaga chiqqandan keyin u o'zini qo'yib yubordi va mashq qilishni to'xtatdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z tashqi ko'rinishiga e'tibor bermaslik.

cards.ex: She has a beautiful figure.
cards.exUz: Uning qomati chiroyli.
cards.uzDef: Odamning tanasining shakli, ayniqsa ayolniki.

cards.ex: He had a twinkle in his eye as he told the story.
cards.exUz: U hikoyani aytayotganda ko'zida uchqun bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'zlari quvonch, hazil yoki yaramaslikni ifodalaydi.

cards.ex: If you want the job, you have to dress the part.
cards.exUz: Agar siz bu ishni xohlasangiz, rolga mos kiyinishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir vaziyat yoki rolga mos ravishda kiyinish.

cards.ex: She was all dolled up for the party.
cards.exUz: U ziyofatga juda bezangan edi.
cards.uzDef: Ajoyib liboslar kiygan va bezangan.

cards.ex: He's the spitting image of his father.
cards.exUz: U otasiga aynan o'xshash.
cards.term: to be the spitting image of
cards.uzDef: Kimdir boshqa odamga juda o'xshash.

cards.ex: After a long day, a hot shower is a sight for sore eyes.
cards.exUz: Uzoq kundan keyin issiq dush ko'zni quvontiruvchi narsa.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir ko'rishdan juda xursand bo'lish.

cards.ex: She got herself done up for the wedding.
cards.exUz: U to'y uchun o'zini bezatdi.
cards.uzDef: O'zini go'zal qilish, odatda maxsus voqea uchun.

cards.ex: The building looked a bit down at heel.
cards.exUz: Bino biroz eski ko'rinardi.
cards.uzDef: Eski va qarovsiz kiyim kiygan.

cards.ex: He's a well-built guy who goes to the gym regularly.
cards.exUz: U muntazam ravishda sport zaliga boradigan baquvvat yigit.
cards.uzDef: Kattalashgan va kuchli tanaga ega bo'lgan.

cards.ex: She takes after her mother in looks.
cards.exUz: U tashqi ko'rinishi bilan onasiga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zosiga tashqi ko'rinishi yoki xarakteri bilan o'xshash bo'lish.

cards.ex: She looks her age, which is a compliment.
cards.exUz: U o'z yoshiga yarasha ko'rinadi, bu maqtanarli.
cards.uzDef: O'z yoshiga mos ko'rinish.

cards.ex: He's a bit on the heavy side, but he's very healthy.
cards.exUz: U bir oz to'lishgan, lekin u juda sog'lom.
cards.term: a bit on the heavy side
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan biroz ko'proq vaznga ega bo'lgan.

cards.ex: She has a slim figure.
cards.exUz: Uning qomati ozg'in.
cards.uzDef: Yupqa va ozg'in, ammo zaif emas.

cards.ex: He clearly has eyes for her.
cards.exUz: Uning ko'zi unga tushgani aniq.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir yoqtirish yoki unga romantik qiziqish bildirish.

cards.ex: The stress of the job has put years on him.
cards.exUz: Ishning stressi uni qarib ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir yoshidan kattaroq ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: The bright colors of the painting immediately catches the eye.
cards.exUz: Rasmning yorqin ranglari darhol ko'zni tortadi.
cards.uzDef: E'tiborni jalb qiladigan darajada diqqatga sazovor.

cards.ex: She has shoulder-length hair.
cards.exUz: Uning sochi yelkagacha.
cards.uzDef: Sochning uzunligi yelkagacha yetadigan.

cards.ex: He's in good shape for his age.
cards.exUz: U o'z yoshi uchun yaxshi formada.
cards.uzDef: Jismonan sog'lom va baquvvat.

cards.ex: He had coarse features, but a kind smile.
cards.exUz: Uning qo'pol xususiyatlari bor edi, lekin mehribon tabassumi bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Yuzning nozik emas, balki katta va kuchli xususiyatlari.

cards.ex: My parents are middle-aged.
cards.exUz: Mening ota-onam o'rta yoshli.
cards.uzDef: Taxminan 45 yoshdan 65 yoshgacha bo'lgan.

cards.ex: Despite his gruff exterior, he has a heart of gold.
cards.exUz: Uning qo'pol tashqi ko'rinishiga qaramay, uning oltin yuragi bor.
cards.uzDef: Juda mehribon va saxiy xarakterga ega bo'lgan.

cards.ex: She was dressed to the nines for the opera.
cards.exUz: U opera uchun juda hashamatli kiyingan edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda chiroyli va hashamatli kiyingan.

cards.ex: He comes across as a very confident person.
cards.exUz: U juda ishonchli odam bo'lib ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Qandaydir taassurot qoldirmoq.

cards.ex: They were struggling financially, but they tried to keep up appearances.
cards.exUz: Ular moliyaviy qiyinchiliklarga duch kelishdi, lekin ular ko'rinishni saqlashga harakat qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z ahvolini yaxshi ko'rsatishga harakat qilish, aslida unday bo'lmasa ham.

cards.ex: She's trying to slim down for her wedding.
cards.exUz: U to'yi uchun ozishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Og'irlikni yo'qotish, ozish.
